value: **Computational & Agent-Based Modeling**: Engages students in constructing, programming, or debugging computational and agent-based simulation models to explore dynamic scientific or social phenomena. Evidence: "Four 5th-grade students individually observed a diffusion experiment and created a model to explain the experiment using domain-specific programming blocks."
